# 3. Concordance UpSet Plot — Canonical Marker Availability Across Datasets

```{r concordance_upset, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}

# Build a binary presence matrix from the existing gene_availability table:
# 1 = marker retained ("Used") in that dataset's analysis, 0 = not
# ("Removed" by filtration or "Absent" from the dataset entirely — both
# treated the same way here, since what matters for concordance is
# whether the marker could be assessed, not why it couldn't).

availability_binary <- gene_availability %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Backbone             = as.integer(Backbone == "Used"),
    GSE271101            = as.integer(GSE271101 == "Used"),
    GSE271456_GSE280017  = as.integer(GSE271456_GSE280017 == "Used"),
    GSE263058            = as.integer(GSE263058 == "Used")
  )

# Matrix for ComplexHeatmap's UpSet: rows = genes, columns = datasets
upset_mat <- as.matrix(availability_binary[, c("Backbone", "GSE271101",
                                                 "GSE271456_GSE280017", "GSE263058")])
rownames(upset_mat) <- availability_binary$Gene
colnames(upset_mat) <- c("Backbone", "GSE271101", "GSE271456/GSE280017", "GSE263058")

comb_mat <- make_comb_mat(upset_mat)

UpSet(
  comb_mat,
  comb_order = order(-comb_size(comb_mat)),
  top_annotation = upset_top_annotation(
    comb_mat,
    add_numbers = TRUE,
    axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))
  ),
  right_annotation = upset_right_annotation(
    comb_mat,
    add_numbers = TRUE,
    axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))
  ),
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  column_title = "Overlap of retained canonical markers across datasets"
)

cat("Markers present in all 4 datasets:", comb_size(comb_mat)[names(comb_size(comb_mat)) == "1111"], "\n")
```

# 5. Comparative Heatmap

```{r heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

# Colour scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

# Stage mapping function
make_row_stage <- function(genes) {
  pluripotency         <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC")
  mesoderm_induction   <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34")
  endothelial_identity <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")
  
  stage_map <- c(
    setNames(rep("Pluripotency",         length(pluripotency)),         pluripotency),
    setNames(rep("Mesoderm induction",   length(mesoderm_induction)),   mesoderm_induction),
    setNames(rep("Endothelial identity", length(endothelial_identity)), endothelial_identity)
  )
  
  factor(stage_map[genes],
         levels = c("Pluripotency", "Mesoderm induction", "Endothelial identity"))
}

# Fixed cell dimensions
cell_w <- unit(6, "mm")
cell_h <- unit(6, "mm")

# Backbone
col_group_backbone <- factor(
  c(rep("iPSC", 3), rep("eMPC", 3), rep("EC", 3)),
  levels = c("iPSC", "eMPC", "EC")
)

ht_backbone <- Heatmap(
  mat_backbone,
  name              = "Z-score_backbone",
  col               = col_fun,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_columns   = FALSE,
  row_split         = make_row_stage(rownames(mat_backbone)),
  column_split      = col_group_backbone,
  show_row_names    = TRUE,
  row_names_side    = "right",
  row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot  = 90,
  column_names_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title      = "GSE214306 (Backbone)",
  column_title_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  row_title         = NULL,
  row_gap           = unit(2, "mm"),
  column_gap        = unit(2, "mm"),
  rect_gp           = gpar(col = "grey70", lwd = 0.5),
  border            = TRUE,
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  width             = cell_w * ncol(mat_backbone),
  height            = cell_h * nrow(mat_backbone)
)
```

# 5.1 Comparative Heatmap - Fixed 16-gene panel

```{r heatmap_fixed_panel, fig.width=13, fig.height=12}

library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

# Full canonical panel, in fixed biological order
canonical_genes <- c(
  "POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC",
  "TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34",
  "PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG"
)

# Biological category for each row
canonical_stage <- factor(
  c(
    rep("Pluripotency", 4),
    rep("Mesoderm / progenitor", 6),
    rep("Endothelial identity", 6)
  ),
  levels = c(
    "Pluripotency",
    "Mesoderm / progenitor",
    "Endothelial identity"
  )
)

# Function to expand each dataset to the complete 16-gene panel
# Genes not available in a dataset are represented as NA
expand_marker_matrix <- function(mat, genes = canonical_genes) {

  out <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = length(genes),
    ncol = ncol(mat),
    dimnames = list(genes, colnames(mat))
  )

  common <- intersect(genes, rownames(mat))
  out[common, ] <- mat[common, , drop = FALSE]

  out
}

# Expand all datasets to the same 16-gene panel
mat_backbone_full  <- expand_marker_matrix(mat_backbone)
mat_gse271101_full <- expand_marker_matrix(mat_gse271101)
mat_gse271456_full <- expand_marker_matrix(mat_gse271456)
mat_gse263058_full <- expand_marker_matrix(mat_gse263058)

# Replace sample names by replicate numbers only
colnames(mat_backbone_full) <- c(
  "1", "2", "3",
  "1", "2", "3",
  "1", "2", "3"
)

colnames(mat_gse271101_full) <- c(
  "1",
  "1", "2", "3",
  "1", "2", "3"
)

colnames(mat_gse271456_full) <- c(
  as.character(1:10),
  as.character(1:10)
)

colnames(mat_gse263058_full) <- c(
  "1", "2", "3",
  "1", "2", "3"
)

# Colour scale
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, 0, 2),
  c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")
)

# Fixed cell dimensions
cell_w <- unit(6, "mm")
cell_h <- unit(6, "mm")

# Extra legend for unavailable markers
lgd_not_retained <- Legend(
  labels = "Not retained",
  legend_gp = gpar(
    fill = "grey85",
    col = "grey70"
  ),
  title = NULL
)

# Helper function
make_fixed_heatmap <- function(
  mat,
  column_groups,
  title,
  legend = FALSE,
  show_group_titles = TRUE
) {

  # Stage labels above each column block
  top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Stage = anno_block(
      gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = NA),
      labels = levels(column_groups),
      labels_gp = gpar(
        fontsize = 9,
        fontface = "bold"
      )
    ),
    show_annotation_name = FALSE,
    height = unit(6, "mm")
  )

  Heatmap(
    mat,
    name                = "z-score\nexpression",
    col                 = col_fun,
    na_col              = "grey85",

    cluster_rows        = FALSE,
    cluster_columns     = FALSE,

    row_split           = canonical_stage,
    column_split        = column_groups,

    top_annotation      = top_ha,

    show_row_names      = TRUE,
    row_names_side      = "right",
    row_names_gp        = gpar(fontsize = 9),

    show_column_names   = TRUE,
    column_names_rot    = 0,
    column_names_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 8),

    column_title        = title,
    column_title_gp     = gpar(
      fontsize = 10,
      fontface = "bold"
    ),

    row_title           = if (show_group_titles) levels(canonical_stage) else NULL,
    row_title_gp        = gpar(
      fontsize = 8,
      fontface = "bold"
    ),
    row_title_rot       = 90,

    row_gap             = unit(2, "mm"),
    column_gap          = unit(2, "mm"),

    rect_gp             = gpar(
      col = "grey70",
      lwd = 0.5
    ),

    border              = TRUE,
    show_heatmap_legend = legend,

    width               = cell_w * ncol(mat),
    height              = cell_h * nrow(mat)
  )
}

# Column groups
col_group_backbone <- factor(
  c(
    rep("iPSC", 3),
    rep("eMPC", 3),
    rep("EC", 3)
  ),
  levels = c("iPSC", "eMPC", "EC")
)

col_group_gse271101 <- factor(
  c(
    rep("iPSC", 1),
    rep("EPC", 3),
    rep("EC", 3)
  ),
  levels = c("iPSC", "EPC", "EC")
)

col_group_gse271456 <- factor(
  c(
    rep("iPSC", 10),
    rep("EC", 10)
  ),
  levels = c("iPSC", "EC")
)

col_group_gse263058 <- factor(
  c(
    rep("iPSC", 3),
    rep("iEC", 3)
  ),
  levels = c("iPSC", "iEC")
)

# Build heatmaps
ht_backbone_full <- make_fixed_heatmap(
  mat_backbone_full,
  col_group_backbone,
  "GSE214306 (Backbone)",
  show_group_titles = TRUE
)

ht_gse271101_full <- make_fixed_heatmap(
  mat_gse271101_full,
  col_group_gse271101,
  "GSE271101",
  show_group_titles = FALSE
)

ht_gse271456_full <- make_fixed_heatmap(
  mat_gse271456_full,
  col_group_gse271456,
  "GSE271456/GSE280017",
  show_group_titles = TRUE
)

ht_gse263058_full <- make_fixed_heatmap(
  mat_gse263058_full,
  col_group_gse263058,
  "GSE263058",
  legend = TRUE,
  show_group_titles = FALSE
)

# Convert to grobs
g1_fixed <- grid.grabExpr(
  draw(
    ht_backbone_full,
    heatmap_legend_side = "right",
    padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm")
  )
)

g2_fixed <- grid.grabExpr(
  draw(
    ht_gse271101_full,
    heatmap_legend_side = "right",
    padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 2), "mm")
  )
)

g3_fixed <- grid.grabExpr(
  draw(
    ht_gse271456_full,
    heatmap_legend_side = "right",
    padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 18), "mm")
  )
)

g4_fixed <- grid.grabExpr(
  draw(
    ht_gse263058_full,
    heatmap_legend_side = "right",
    heatmap_legend_list = list(lgd_not_retained),
    padding = unit(c(2, 30, 2, 2), "mm")
  )
)

# Display
grid.arrange(
  g1_fixed, g2_fixed,
  g3_fixed, g4_fixed,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 1),
  heights = c(1, 1.3),
  padding = unit(0, "mm")
)

# Export
pdf(
  "results/comparative_heatmap_fixed_panel.pdf",
  width = 13,
  height = 12
)

grid.arrange(
  g1_fixed, g2_fixed,
  g3_fixed, g4_fixed,
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 1),
  heights = c(1, 1.3),
  padding = unit(0, "mm")
)

dev.off()
```

# 6. Expression Profiles

```{r expression_profiles, message=FALSE,  fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# STEP 1: Calculate mean z-score per stage per gene per dataset

# Helper function
mean_by_stage <- function(mat, stage_assignments) {
  stages <- unique(stage_assignments)
  result <- sapply(stages, function(s) {
    cols <- names(stage_assignments[stage_assignments == s])
    if (length(cols) == 1) mat[, cols]
    else rowMeans(mat[, cols, drop = FALSE])
  })
  as.data.frame(result)
}

# Stage assignments
stages_backbone <- c(
  iPSC_1 = "iPSC", iPSC_2 = "iPSC", iPSC_3 = "iPSC",
  eMPC_1 = "Progenitor-like", eMPC_2 = "Progenitor-like", eMPC_3 = "Progenitor-like",
  EC_1   = "EC",  EC_2   = "EC",  EC_3   = "EC"
)

stages_gse271101 <- c(
  iPSC_1 = "iPSC",
  EPC_1  = "Progenitor-like", EPC_2 = "Progenitor-like", EPC_3 = "Progenitor-like",
  EC_1   = "EC",  EC_2  = "EC",  EC_3  = "EC"
)

stages_gse271456 <- c(
  setNames(rep("iPSC", 10), paste0("iPSC_", 1:10)),
  setNames(rep("EC",   10), paste0("EC_",   1:10))
)

stages_gse263058 <- c(
  iPSC_1 = "iPSC", iPSC_2 = "iPSC", iPSC_3 = "iPSC",
  iEC_1  = "EC",   iEC_2  = "EC",   iEC_3  = "EC"
)

# Calculate means
means_backbone  <- mean_by_stage(mat_backbone,  stages_backbone)
means_gse271101 <- mean_by_stage(mat_gse271101, stages_gse271101)
means_gse271456 <- mean_by_stage(mat_gse271456, stages_gse271456)
means_gse263058 <- mean_by_stage(mat_gse263058, stages_gse263058)

# STEP 2: Build long data frame
to_long <- function(means_df, dataset_name) {
  means_df$gene    <- rownames(means_df)
  means_df$dataset <- dataset_name
  pivot_longer(means_df,
               cols      = -c(gene, dataset),
               names_to  = "stage",
               values_to = "mean_z")
}

df_long <- bind_rows(
  to_long(means_backbone,  "GSE214306 (Backbone)"),
  to_long(means_gse271101, "GSE271101"),
  to_long(means_gse271456, "GSE271456/GSE280017"),
  to_long(means_gse263058, "GSE263058")
)

# Set stage order
df_long$stage <- factor(df_long$stage,
                         levels = c("iPSC", "Progenitor-like", "EC"))

# Dataset colours
dataset_colours <- c(
  "GSE214306 (Backbone)" = "#1b7837",
  "GSE271101"            = "#762a83",
  "GSE271456/GSE280017"  = "#d6604d",
  "GSE263058"            = "#4393c3"
)

# Dataset linetypes: solid for 3-stage, dashed for 2-stage
dataset_linetypes <- c(
  "GSE214306 (Backbone)" = "solid",
  "GSE271101"            = "solid",
  "GSE271456/GSE280017"  = "dashed",
  "GSE263058"            = "dashed"
)

# STEP 3: Full figure - all markers
p_all <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x        = stage,
                              y        = mean_z,
                              colour   = dataset,
                              linetype = dataset,
                              group    = dataset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_colour_manual(name   = "Dataset", values = dataset_colours) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Dataset", values = dataset_linetypes) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x     = "Differentiation stage",
       y     = "Mean row-wise z-score expression",
       title = "Expression profiles of canonical markers across datasets")

p_all

# STEP 4: Three separate figures by marker group
genes_pluripotency <- c("POU5F1", "SOX2", "KLF4", "MYC")
genes_mesoderm     <- c("TBXT", "MIXL1", "EOMES", "ETV2", "KDR", "CD34")
genes_endothelial  <- c("PECAM1", "CDH5", "VWF", "NOS3", "SOX17", "ERG")

plot_group <- function(genes_subset, title_label, ncol_facet = 3) {
  df_subset      <- df_long[df_long$gene %in% genes_subset, ]
  df_subset$gene <- factor(df_subset$gene, levels = genes_subset)

  ggplot(df_subset, aes(x        = stage,
                         y        = mean_z,
                         colour   = dataset,
                         linetype = dataset,
                         group    = dataset)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    scale_colour_manual(name   = "Dataset", values = dataset_colours) +
    scale_linetype_manual(name = "Dataset", values = dataset_linetypes) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 14),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 14),
      strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    ) +
    labs(x     = "Differentiation stage",
         y     = "Mean z-score",
         title = title_label)
}

p_pluripotency <- plot_group(genes_pluripotency,
                              "Expression profiles — Pluripotency markers",
                              ncol_facet = 2)

p_mesoderm     <- plot_group(genes_mesoderm,
                              "Expression profiles — Mesoderm / progenitor markers",
                              ncol_facet = 3)

p_endothelial  <- plot_group(genes_endothelial,
                              "Expression profiles — Endothelial identity markers",
                              ncol_facet = 3)

p_pluripotency
p_mesoderm
p_endothelial

# Export expression profiles
ggsave("results/expression_profiles_pluripotency.pdf",
       plot = p_pluripotency, width = 12, height = 8)

ggsave("results/expression_profiles_mesoderm.pdf",
       plot = p_mesoderm, width = 12, height = 8)

ggsave("results/expression_profiles_endothelial.pdf",
       plot = p_endothelial, width = 12, height = 8)
```
